BSX.drawdown: -55% from a Sept-2025 high; -47% over six months
BSX.CAUSE FOUND \u2014 company's own words: 10-Q filed 2026-08-03: 'Net sales for the second quarter and first six months of 2026 were impacted by INCREASED COMPETITION WITHIN OUR ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY BUSINESS UNIT and a DECELERATION OF CERTAIN WATCHMAN PROCEDURES.' Both growth engines — Farapulse PFA and WATCHMAN — are the ones decelerating.
BSX.AGGRAVATING \u2014 SECURITIES CLASS ACTI: the 10-Q discloses a 10(b)/20(a) suit alleging false statements about financial guidance AND specifically 'anticipated growth in the U.S. electrophysiology business unit'. Indiana Public Retirement System appointed lead plaintiff 2026-05-20; amended complaint 2026-07-20 adding Miami Fire/Police and Detroit General. So the market is pricing a growth deceleration that is ALSO the subject of a disclosure-integrity claim.
BSX.management_response: $1.5B MiRus TAVR investment (May-18, 33.75% + call option on a TAVR NewCo) + $2B accelerated share repurchase at $52.68 (May-18) + a 2026 Restructuring Plan approved Jul-21 ($700-800M pre-tax charges, ~$500M annual savings, complete by 2029). A company buying its own stock hard and cutting $500M of cost.
BSX.Q2_actuals: gross profit $3.848B vs $3.424B; operating income $1.178B vs $819M; net income $905M vs $795M — the P&L is still GROWING. This is a MULTIPLE de-rate on decelerating growth expectations, not an earnings collapse.
BSX.COURT_FRAME: this is the archetype the generator was built to find — quality economics, multiple compressed on a nameable and non-terminal cause — EXCEPT the integrity overhang. Our own doctrine has a class for exactly this: RP_TAINTED (integrity-flagged names ownable but never RP_FAIR, 7-condition gate). Court it as RP_TAINTED, not RP_FAIR.
BSX.verify_next: the class action's specific allegation vs the actual guidance language; EP competitive share data (J&J Varipulse, Medtronic PulseSelect); whether WATCHMAN deceleration is procedure-mix or share loss

DXCM.drawdown: -38% from an Apr-2024 high, but +20.4% over six months
DXCM.CAUSE \u2014 ALREADY RESOLVING: Q2-2026 (filed 07-30): revenue +13% to $1.308B, US +11%, intl +19%, GAAP operating margin 24.3% = +590bps YoY. Positive CONNECT RCT in type-2 non-insulin. New long-term outlook through 2030 at a 2026 Investor Day.
DXCM.READ: the drawdown is TWO YEARS OLD (high Apr-2024) and the business has re-accelerated with margins expanding 590bps. This is the LATE case — the de-rate happened, the recovery is visible, and the stock is already +20% over six months. Ask whether we are late rather than early.
DXCM.COURT_FRAME: weakest 'dislocation' claim in the cohort BECAUSE the repair is already in the tape and the print. Court on valuation, not on drawdown.

ALNY.CAUSE \u2014 NOT AN EARNINGS PROBLEM: Q2-2026: net product revenues $1.172B vs $672M (+74%), total revenues $1.291B vs $774M (+67%), royalty revenue $71.7M vs $40.0M. R&D $413M vs $324M.
ALNY.READ: a 55% drawdown against +67% revenue growth is the widest fundamentals-vs-price gap in the cohort. The cause is therefore NOT in the income statement — it is expectations/valuation (a biotech that re-rated on AMVUTTRA's ATTR-CM opportunity and then de-rated), or competitive (BridgeBio/Pfizer in ATTR), or pipeline. THE CAUSE IS NOT YET FOUND and that is the finding.
ALNY.COURT_FRAME: do NOT court until the cause is identified. Apply catalyst-identity binding — bind any thesis to the SPECIFIC product/trial, not the platform. The most interesting shape here and the least explained.
